Kind 10011 had two documented meanings. The NIP repository separated them.

NIP-39 keeps kind 10011 for cross-platform identity claims and adds Bluesky and Discord. NIP-51 moves favorite follow sets to kind 10021.

The merged text defines no migration for old favorite-list events. Clients still need to handle that boundary.
